top_signals.title: Bringing the current MFF to a successful close: agreement on the final Annual Budget *
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 11 Nov 2026 The Commission welcomes the agreement reached last evening between the European Parliament and the Council of the European Union on the annual EU budget 2027.
